items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: at the time there was a union delegate named Redman

ctx.x: less. You know, the band would stop and I would play for Bill. He had this beautiful routine; he was quite a dancer.

There came a time, though, I told him... I said there's a piano player outside there; he wanted to get in the union. That was Erroll. I said, "Have him play for you, let him play for you and I'll take a rest with the band." He says, "Okay." So I got Erroll to play for Bill. When Bill came back, he says, "Oh no, man, I don't want him to play for me." "Why not?" Well, the fact remains that Erroll was just so superb that he was taking the spot away from Bill! If Bill does a routine, Erroll would do it on the piano,…
So getting back to Tondelayo's(?), we used to talk about that. We had a pretty nice thing going there at Tondelayo's(?). After that I just...
